description: This file defines the SkillPromptInjectionHandler class responsible for extracting skill content and files from ZIP archives, injecting skill content into prompts for different API formats, and converting skills into function/tool definitions for language models. It facilitates integration of skill content for prompt engineering and model interaction in a system that manages skills stored as ZIP files.

classes.name: SkillPromptInjectionHandler
classes.description: Handles skill content extraction from ZIP files and their injection into system prompts for language models.

methods.name: Optional[str] extract_skill_content(self, skill: LiteLLM_SkillsTable)
methods.description: Extracts and returns the main content (SKILL.md or README.md) from a skill ZIP archive or default instructions if extraction fails.

methods.name: Dict[str,bytes] extract_all_files(self, skill: LiteLLM_SkillsTable)
methods.description: Extracts all files from a skill ZIP archive, returning a dictionary of file paths and binary contents, with directories skipped.

methods.name: dict inject_skill_content_to_messages( self, data: dict, skill_contents: List[str], use_anthropic_format: bool = False )
methods.description: Injects skill content into message prompts, either at the top-level 'system' parameter for Anthropic or within the messages array for OpenAI-style APIs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_execute_code_tool(self, skill_modules: List[str])
methods.description: Generates a tool definition that allows execution of Python code with access to skill modules.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] convert_skill_to_tool(self, skill: LiteLLM_SkillsTable)
methods.description: Converts a LiteLLM skill object into an OpenAI-style function component with description and parameters.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] convert_skill_to_anthropic_tool(self, skill: LiteLLM_SkillsTable)
methods.description: Converts a LiteLLM skill object into an Anthropic-style tool with name, description, and input schema.
